survey: A gold three-branch candelabra stands on a round, stepped foot that sits flat on an unseen surface. A single turned stem with knops rises from the foot. Two U-shaped arms leave a collar at mid-height, symmetrically left and right, and both lie in a plane that faces the camera. Each arm ends in a round drip pan and cup holding a cream candle, and the central cup sits on top of the stem. The camera is roughly level with the candle cups and looks slightly down. As a result, the foot's ellipses are the most open, the stem collars are narrower, and the drip pans and candle tops are almost edge-on. That is the right progression for one viewpoint. The candles and stem stay vertical and parallel. The two arms mirror each other, and their cups sit at matching heights. The foot sits level with no tilt against the implied ground.
